item.title: Moonstruck
item.description: <figcaption> Woke up at 12.15 am, drove an hour from San Mateo to Livermore, California and captured the blood moon. It's the first time I have experienced totality that lasted a whole hour - plenty of time to enjoy the moment, take photographs and get a midnight snack </figcaption>

item.title: Starstruck
item.description: <figcaption> April 8 2024 is ingrained, burnt into my eyes. Witnessing a solar eclipse is easily one of the best experiences I have had </figcaption>
